title: Probe-runner: lightweight workload-specific evals on catalog & tenant-locked version revisions
creator: Aisha Mendes
description: Problem: Model-version changes (catalog updates or tenant-locked/tenant-controlled pins) sometimes introduce subtle quality regressions that full preflight evals catch too slowly or at too high cost. We need a lightweight, automated probe that runs immediately on pin/upgrade events to provide quick signal and gate risky rollouts without running the full eval harness.
goal: Ship a Probe-runner service that triggers small, targeted evaluation probes on every catalog revision and tenant-locked version transition. Probes must be workload-specific, fast (< 10 minutes), low-cost, and yield actionable pass/fail signals integrated into the rollout pipeline and Console alerts.
approach: Trigger points: catalog change event, tenant version lock/pin change, manual 'apply pin' action in Console

Probe composition: run 50-300 lightweight checks selected from a tenant-aware blend of (a) tenant representative samples (if available) and (b) catalog-level smoke tests for regressions in latency, prompt-output similarity, safety flags, and structured output validity
Sampling and cost control: adaptive sample sizing (smaller for low-risk updates), use cached prefix responses, and prefer low-cost runtime (e.g., cpu/light-quantized nodes) for probes where possible
Signal thresholds: define per-metric thresholds (e.g., >5% drop in similarity, >2x increase in safety flags, >20ms median token latency increase) to mark a probe as failed

Integration: integrate probe outcomes into rollout controller to auto-hold or mark for manual review, surface results in Console rollout UI, and send notifications to configured owners and on-call channels
Fallbacks: if probe infrastructure unavailable, mark as 'probe-skipped' and surface advisory; do not auto-approve without explicit override
Auditability: persist probe inputs, outputs, and metrics for 30 days for triage and compliance
acceptance_criteria: Probe-runner executes within 10 minutes for 95% of pin/upgrade events
Default probe cost per run is < $3 on average for catalog-only probes
Probe result (pass/fail/skip) appears in rollout UI and in event timeline
Rollout controller can auto-hold upgrades when probe fails and create a follow-up investigation ticket
Probe configuration supports tenant overrides (sampling size, metric thresholds) and product can opt-out per-tenant
Documentation (Confluence) and runbook posted with triage steps and recommended next actions
